title: Guess the animal!

creative.hook: Two visual-free clues invite children to identify a striped mystery animal.
creative.learningGoal: Use descriptive clues to identify a zebra and learn that stripe patterns are individual.
creative.signatureMoment: The hidden zebra appears only after the answer is locked in.

researchSources.title: San Diego Zoo Wildlife Explorers - Zebra

clues: I have black and white stripes.
I look a little like a horse.
funFact: Every zebra has its own unique stripe pattern.
